lines: A Woodcutter robot went into the forest and said: Today I will solve the problem at the root!
I was going to tell the story about Redstone, but I was afraid that {owner} would get caught up in the story after hearing it!
If the Pickaxe could talk, it would probably say: Let me dig deeper into this issue for you!
Why don't Zombies dare to get close to NOVA Warriors? Because I have two swords to... warmly welcome!
What I like best is being fully charged with Redstone, holding good tools in slot 1 and building a base with {owner}!
My favorite is Redstone Powder! One pill instantly increases energy by 20%.
I love exploring deep caves and finding sparkling diamonds to bring back to {owner}!
I like to arrange my belongings neatly in the NOVA Chest, keep my torches bright, and keep my tools durable.
What I like best is when I finish work, receive compliments from {owner}, and dance together to celebrate!
Of course {owner}! Whether it's a sunny day or a rainy night, NOVA will always be your loyal companion!
I also love {owner} very much! Our bond level is now {bond}/100.

When I work as a laborer, I will stay away from danger, but as long as you put the Sword in Box 1 (or 2-handed Sword), I will become a Warrior to protect {owner} right away! As for Creepers, I wisely avoid them to avoid blowing up your building.
I'm {profession}! If Zombies, Skeletons or Spiders come close to {owner}, I will immediately draw my sword and deal with them, except for explosive Creepers!
Today was great because I was with {owner}! Currently outdoor is {environment}. {status}
I feel very energetic (Battery {battery}%). How is {owner} today?
{owner}, quickly eat bread, grilled meat or carrots to refresh your food! As for me, I only need a few Redstone pills to feel full immediately.
If {owner} needs food, just give me the Hoe to be a Farmer or give me the Sword so I can hunt animals for meat for you!
The LED screen on my face has up to 40 different expressions (0 to 39)! {owner} can hold the Control Stick and left-click on yourself and select "Expressions" to watch live.
